notes.subject: tent-cord
notes.rationale: יתר literally the tent-cord pulled up so the tent collapses; some render 'their excess/remainder is drawn out', losing the tent-death image.

notes.subject: נסע יתר
notes.rationale: The verse sustains the house-of-clay / tent imagery of 4:19 — death as pulling up the tent-pins; the picture is kept, not smoothed to 'perish'.

notes.subject: and not in wisdom
notes.rationale: Read as 'they die without wisdom' (die untaught) or 'not by wisdom' (God does not need wisdom to strike them).

translation: Is not their tent-cord pulled up within them? They die, and not in wisdom.
